inputs.share_count_basis: ADS-equivalent millions (1 ADS = 4 ordinary shares) so per-share values are per ADS, matching the NYSE quote. Built from the FY2025 20-F count of 460,683,644 ordinary shares at 2026-03-31, less the post-Mar-31 part of the completed US$200M program (10,627,269 ADS total; ~588,766 ADS fell in Q1, inferred from the 463,038,708 Dec-25 cover count) and the 1,895,093 ADS bought under the new US$400M program by 2026-08-14 (Q2-26 6-K) = 412.95M ordinary, plus 1.10M dilutive (Q2-26 diluted minus basic weighted) = 414.05M ordinary = 103.51M ADS. Held FLAT: SBC is fully expensed in the flows. Repurchases after 2026-08-14 are not counted, and neither is the cash they used, so the two stay consistent.
inputs.cash_composition: 2026-06-30 balance sheet (Q2-26 6-K ex99.1): cash and equivalents 2,495.8 + short-term investments 15,659.1 + other long-term investments 1,209.7 = RMB 19,364.6m, the company's own 'RMB 19.36 billion' figure. Restricted cash (81.3) excluded. No borrowings.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 20-F cash flow statement add-back RMB 218,974k. PRC employees settle on gross exercise and there is no net-share-settlement withholding line, so the add-back is the full charge.
inputs.interest_income_source: FY2025 20-F income statement: 'Interest and investment income, net' RMB 659,810k (FY2024 791,905k; FY2023 831,006k). It runs through net income, so it sits inside OCF. Stripped because the RMB 19.4bn pile that earns it is added in the bridge.
inputs.last_fcf_note: Owner FCF = 771.4 - 219.0 - 659.8 = -107.4. FY2025 reported OCF (889.5) carries a ~RMB 0.8bn working-capital unwind: accrued expenses -594, AR -189, deferred revenue -106. Pre-working-capital operating owner FCF was about RMB 0.7bn (op-adj EBITDA 1,173 - SBC 219 - capex 118 - operating cash tax ~100). The engine starts from base_revenue and the component paths, not from last_fcf.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 financing outflow RMB 1,051,983k (20-F). In 2026 the company completed the US$200M program (10.63M ADS, Mar 5 to Jul 30) and started a US$400M 12-month program on 2026-07-28 (US$43.6M spent by Aug 14). It is a real repurchaser, so the flat count is funded. Buybacks run at roughly 4-5x SBC, which makes them a return of excess cash.
inputs.dividend_note: Board policy is no less than RMB 1.5bn a year for 2024-2026 (20-F). Future dividends are a distribution of the cash already in the bridge and are value-neutral. Only the declared-but-unpaid RMB 489.8m at Jun-30 is deducted.
inputs.fx_note: Flows and balance sheet in RMB (ISO CNY). Quote is USD per ADS (1 ADS = 4 ordinary shares). model->quote rate 0.149283 USD per CNY = 1/6.6987, from Yahoo CNY=X at 2026-10-02T21:32Z. Parity check against HKEX 2518.HK: HK$41.40 x 4 / 7.8463 (Yahoo HKD=X, 2026-10-02) = US$21.11 per ADS-equivalent vs US$20.56 for the ADS, a 2.6% gap. The HK last trade is 2026-09-30, before the Oct 1-2 HK holidays. The Q2-26 release translated at 6.7851 (Jun-30 noon buying rate).
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in RMB, the currency of the flows: China 10y government bond ~1.9% + beta ~1.0 x China ERP ~6.5% + 2.0pp VIE/HFCAA/capital-repatriation premium = ~10.4%, rounded to 10.5%. All-equity, no debt. The VIE premium sits ONLY in the discount rate and is applied identically to all three scenarios. No scenario WACC differences, so risk is charged once. Business risk (traffic share loss, auto downturn) lives in the scenario flows and weights.
inputs.lease_treatment: US GAAP operating leases: straight-line lease cost (ROU amortisation 88.8 in FY2025) already sits inside operating expenses, so it is inside the EBITDA margin (treatment B). Lease liabilities are excluded from net debt. lease_cost_pct_path left at 0 to avoid a second charge.
inputs.nci_treatment: TTP Car (51%-owned used-car auction platform, loss-making) is consolidated, so the flows bear 100% of its losses. The NCI share of TTP losses (RMB 52.7m FY2025) is not credited back, which is mildly conservative. The convertible redeemable NCI (TTP Series C/E preferred; US GAAP mezzanine RMB 2,220m, IFRS fair value only ~RMB 27m) is TTP's obligation, not Autohome's. The bridge deducts only the outstanding US$20.59m Series C redemption notice (20-F note 19). Deducting the full US GAAP carrying value instead would cost ~US$3.0/ADS. See key_risks.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF with non-US adaptations (currency-matched RMB WACC, USD per-ADS outputs, lease treatment B, NCI charged once, PRC withholding tax on repatriated cash in the bridge). Autohome is an operating company (consumer-internet marketplace and media) with no deposits, no fair-value property book and no going-concern question, so the SKILL.md routing table puts it on the non-US operating row. First valuation; no MEMORY.md entry. CYCLE FRAMING: FY2020 (rev 8,659, op-adj EBITDA ~41%) is the peak and is NOT the anchor. FY2025 (18.2% op-adj EBITDA margin) is itself a downtrend year, and FY2026 is a trough (H1-26 revenue -30% YoY, Q1 operating loss). The base case starts from the 2026 trough and recovers margin only to about FY2025's 18%, not toward the 2019-21 levels. VALUE STRUCTURE: at the price the ADS trades below the adjusted net cash (~RMB 17.4bn after the bridge items = ~US$25.1/ADS). The market is ascribing negative value to the operating business, or discounting the cash for VIE/repatriation/governance risk. That gap is the thesis, not a modelling artefact. Interest income is stripped from flows because the cash is in the bridge. KNOWN SMALL OVERLAP: the Jun-30 cash already contains H1-26 operating flows, and the FY2026 year-1 flow counts them again. H1-26 operating owner FCF was roughly RMB 0.1-0.2bn (~US$0.2/ADS), left in as immaterial.

~4.96M ADS from the completed US$200M program at its US$18.82 average (US$93.3m) plus US$43.6m under the new program = US$136.9m x 6.6987. Matches the Aug-14 share count.

equity_bridge.note: 5% HK-treaty rate x RMB 15,647.6m undistributed earnings with no DTL recognised (FY2025 20-F tax note). This is the friction on getting the onshore cash to ADS holders. The rate rises to 10% if treaty benefits are denied.

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR (+5.5%) diverges by more than 30% from revenue (-5.7%) and EPS (-15.5%). Book value grew on retained interest income from the cash pile and on earlier profits, not on operating growth, so it is not the growth anchor here. Revenue CAGR is selected instead.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series = reported FCF - SBC - interest and investment income (FY2020-22 non-operating income derived as pretax minus operating profit). It turns negative in FY2025, so owner-FCF CAGRs are undefined (null). Reported FCF fell ~24%/yr over 5 years, but owner FCF fell faster: interest income was a rising share of reported FCF (86% in FY2025), so the reported series overstates the operating business. SBC is small (~3% of revenue) and is not the driver of the gap.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 -26%: H1-26 2,246 (-30% YoY) plus H2-26 ~2,527 (-22% on H2-25's 3,240), since management expects a partial H2 media recovery while the low-margin vehicle-sales marketplace revenue keeps shrinking. Then a further leg down in FY2027 as China PV retail sales stay weak after 2026's ~-16% and dealer counts fall, followed by flat and low single digits once the mix settles on leads, data and the new transaction products.
base.ebitda_margin_rationale: Operating adjusted EBITDA (operating profit + D&A + SBC, EXCLUDING interest income, which the company's own Adjusted EBITDA includes): FY2024 19.8%, FY2025 18.2%, H1-26 12.6% ex-severance (Q1 8.7%, Q2 15.9%). The FY2026 13% includes the RMB 61.8m severance. Recovery to 18%, about the FY2025 level, comes from the cost cuts already visible in Q2's 77% gross margin and from the mix shift away from low-margin vehicle sales. No return to the 2019-21 30-40% margins.
base.tax_rationale: PRC 25% EIT, with HNTE 15% at key subsidiaries and R&D super-deductions. FY2025 cash tax paid was 188 on pretax 1,532, which includes taxed interest income. Operating rate 18-20% including the 5% treaty WHT on distributed earnings.
base.wc_rationale: Dealer subscriptions are prepaid (deferred revenue), so a shrinking top line releases deferred revenue and consumes cash. 10% of the revenue change, below the FY2024-25 unwind pace, which also carried one-off accrual reversals.
base.terminal_rationale: 1.0% RMB nominal terminal growth for a structurally challenged platform. Gordon at 10.5%/1% is ~10.6x, so the 10x cap binds.

scenario_narratives.base: China's 2026 auto downturn (PV retail ~-16%, the price war, NEV growth turning negative) pushes FY2026 revenue down ~26% to ~RMB 4.8bn and another 6% in FY2027 as paying-dealer counts and lead-gen ARPU keep falling and Dongchedi/Douyin hold their traffic gains. The decline then flattens, because the low-margin vehicle-sales marketplace revenue has already been shed and media stabilises with new-model launches. Cost discipline lifts operating adjusted EBITDA back to ~18%, about FY2025's level. The operating business is worth ~RMB 4.4bn (~US$6.3/ADS), about a fifth of the ADS value. Most of the value is the RMB 19.4bn cash pile less the bridge items, which keeps being returned through the RMB 1.5bn+ dividend and the US$400M buyback.
scenario_narratives.bull: The auto market stabilises in 2027 and management's pivot works: the used-car full-process platform goes national, cross-border used-car export scales, the 'Autohome Good Car' franchise and the Cheese Car Butler AI agent turn traffic into transaction and data revenue, and Ping An cross-sell adds financing and insurance take. Revenue troughs in FY2026 and compounds at mid-single digits. Margins rebuild toward ~24% on the higher-margin data and leads mix, which is still far below the 2019-21 ~40%. The market stops pricing the cash pile at a discount as buybacks retire ~15% of the float a year at below-cash prices.
scenario_narratives.bear: This is structural disintermediation, not a cycle: NEV brands sell direct through owned apps, dealers build proprietary channels, and ByteDance's Dongchedi and JD's Yiche take the remaining ad budgets. Revenue falls another ~30% in FY2026 and keeps shrinking through FY2031. Fixed content and tech costs cap operating adjusted EBITDA near 12%, and management spends on low-return new-retail and used-car capex (3% of revenue) to defend relevance. The operating business is worth roughly RMB 1.2bn (~US$1.7/ADS), and the ADS is supported almost entirely by the cash, which is also the asset most exposed to the VIE, repatriation and controlling-shareholder risks this model can only partly price.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear 30% (above the 15% default) because the revenue decline has run for five years, the Q1-26 operating loss shows operating deleverage, and the turnaround rests on unproven pivots. Base 50%: the trough-then-flatten path follows from the visible mix shift and cost cuts. Bull 20% (below the 35% default) because it needs both an auto-market recovery and several early-stage initiatives to succeed at once.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Owner-FCF DCF in RMB at a 10.5% VIE-inclusive cost of equity, with the large net cash added in the bridge after the PRC withholding tax needed to get it offshore, and per-ADS values converted to USD. The operating business is valued from a 2026 trough, with margin recovery capped near FY2025's level rather than mean-reverting to the FY2019-21 peak. Most of the value is the cash, so the valuation is mainly a judgment on whether that cash reaches minority ADS holders.
key_risks_to_valuation: Cash accessibility: ~80% of base-case value is the RMB 19.4bn cash and investment pile, mostly onshore and in RMB. VIE unwinding, capital controls, the WHT rate rising to 10% (another ~RMB 0.8bn, ~US$1.1/ADS), or Ping An-directed uses (related-party deposits and products produced RMB 114m of FY2025 interest income) would impair it

TTP Car redeemable preferred: the bridge deducts only the US$20.6m outstanding redemption notice. If the full US GAAP mezzanine carrying value (RMB 2.22bn) were ever a group cash claim, value falls ~US$3.0/ADS
Operating trough deeper or longer than the base: Q1-26 was an operating loss. Two years of bear-path revenue would leave the operating business near zero value
HFCAA/US-China delisting risk on the ADS (the HKEX 2518 line mitigates it) and governance risk from Ping An's controlling stake
Capital allocation: management could redirect the cash from buybacks and dividends to low-return new-retail or used-car ventures
